title: 第23章 最后一战二阶灵兵第24章 临阵突破炼体八重
content_zh:
“苏清雪，来战！”
少年的话语响彻在演武场之中。
这一刻，在场的众人没有任何一人看好苏清雪。
苏清雪觉醒六品武魂，天赋固然强大，然而她毕竟才刚刚觉醒。
即使她的天赋再怎么超然，半个月时间，她的修为又能提升多少？
在亲眼目睹了叶无尘强势击败叶青之后，众人仿佛又看到了四年前那傲立于京城之中，横扫各大年轻一辈的少年。
“叶无尘，你还记得我刚刚在看台上跟你说过的话吗？”
“我当时就说过，今日的族比，你若不来，还能少受一点屈辱。”
苏清雪看向叶无尘，继续开口道：
“战胜了叶青，你现在是不是很骄傲，认为所有人在你面前都不堪一击？”
“醒醒吧，叶无尘，我说了，我们现在是两个世界的人！”
话音落下，苏清雪身上的气势疯狂的绽放出来。
她的身后，一柄虚幻的长剑悬浮在天幕之中。
“通窍境！”
看台之上，众人看着这一幕心头深深的颤动了起来。
苏清雪，竟然突破到了通窍境！
苏清雪的身后，赫然便是她觉醒的武魂，清霜剑。
而要想将武魂虚影显化出来，其修为必定踏入了通窍境。
众人皆是不解，半个月前苏清雪才觉醒武魂。
她又是如何在短短的半个月时间突破到通窍境的。

“怎么样，叶无尘，看到我们之间的差距了吗？”
苏清雪淡漠的话语传入了叶无尘的耳中。
叶无尘强势击败叶青之后，剑指苏清雪。
就当所有人都认为苏清雪不可能是叶无尘对手的时候，苏清雪却已然突破到了通窍境。
如此戏剧化的剧情，将众人的期待感都拉至了巅峰。
“叶无尘，看在相识一场的份上，我最后再给你一次机会，认输吧。”
苏清雪站立在看台上，低头俯瞰着擂台上的叶无尘。
叶无尘抬头，对上了苏清雪那双清冷的眸子。
他虽然不知道苏清雪是用了什么方式才达到的通窍境，但他不在乎。
他心中坚信，唯有凭借自己一步一个脚印踏出来的路，才算是完整的武道之路。
“你是怕了吗？”
叶无尘冷笑着回应道。
“罢了，既然你执意如此，那我便赐你一场大败，让你知道我们之间的差距。”
在众人的注视下，苏清雪缓步走下看台，她的身影缓缓朝叶无尘靠近。
每走一步，苏清雪身上的气势就更甚一分。
远远看去，就如同一尊清冷的女武神一般。
而叶无尘依旧傲立原地，白衣染血，其战意欲凌天。
“你出手吧。”
苏清雪淡淡开口道。
看着此时苏清雪高傲的模样，叶无尘只觉得好笑。

不论何时，战场之上轻视对手都是大忌。
不过他也懒的去管对方，只见他的右脚狠狠踏在演武场的地面之上，身形迅速朝对方靠近。
一阵狂风袭来，叶无尘已然出现在苏清雪身前。
而这一刻，苏清雪动了。
content_en:
"Su Qingxue, come and fight!"
The young man's words echoed throughout the martial arts arena.
At this moment, no one present was optimistic about Su Qingxue.
Su Qingxue has awakened the sixth-grade martial spirit. Although her talent is powerful, she has just awakened after all.
No matter how extraordinary her talent is, how much can her cultivation improve in half a month?
After witnessing Ye Wuchen's powerful defeat of Ye Qing, everyone seemed to see the young man who stood proudly in the capital four years ago and swept away all the younger generations.
"Ye Wuchen, do you still remember what I just said to you in the stands?"
"I said back then that if you didn't come to today's clan competition, you would have suffered less humiliation."
Su Qingxue looked at Ye Wuchen and continued:
"After defeating Ye Qing, are you very proud now and think that everyone is vulnerable to you?"
"Wake up, Ye Wuchen, I told you, we are in two different worlds now!"
After the words fell, Su Qingxue's aura bloomed crazily.
Behind her, an illusory long sword was suspended in the sky.
"Tongqiao Realm!"
In the stands, everyone's hearts trembled deeply as they watched this scene.
Su Qingxue actually broke through to the Aperture Realm!
Behind Su Qingxue was her awakened martial spirit, the Qingshuang Sword.
And in order to manifest the phantom of the martial soul, one's cultivation level must have entered the Aperture Realm.
Everyone is puzzled. Su Qingxue only awakened her martial spirit half a month ago.
How did she break through to the Aperture Realm in just half a month?
"How about it, Ye Wuchen, do you see the gap between us?"
Su Qingxue's indifferent words reached Ye Wuchen's ears.
After Ye Wuchen defeated Ye Qing forcefully, he pointed his sword at Su Qingxue.
Just when everyone thought that Su Qingxue could not be Ye Wuchen's opponent, Su Qingxue had already broken through to the Aperture Realm.
Such a dramatic plot has raised everyone's expectations to the peak.
"Ye Wuchen, for the sake of our acquaintance, I will give you one last chance. Just admit defeat."
Su Qingxue stood in the stands, looking down at Ye Wuchen on the ring.
Ye Wuchen raised his head and met Su Qingxue's cold eyes.
Although he didn't know what method Su Qingxue used to reach the Aperture Realm, he didn't care.
He firmly believes in his heart that only by relying on the path he takes step by step can he be considered a complete martial arts path.
"Are you scared?"
Ye Wuchen responded with a sneer.
"Well, since you insist on doing this, I will give you a big defeat to let you know the gap between us."
Under the gaze of everyone, Su Qingxue slowly walked down the stand, and her figure slowly approached Ye Wuchen.
With every step she took, Su Qingxue's aura became stronger.
From a distance, she looks like a cold Valkyrie.
But Ye Wuchen still stood proudly, his white clothes stained with blood, and his fighting spirit was as high as the sky.
"You take action."
Su Qingxue said lightly.
Seeing Su Qingxue's arrogant look at this time, Ye Wuchen only felt funny.
At any time, it is taboo to underestimate your opponent on the battlefield.
However, he was too lazy to pay attention to the other party. He only saw his right foot stepping hard on the ground of the martial arts field, and his figure quickly approached the other party.
A gust of wind hit, and Ye Wuchen appeared in front of Su Qingxue.
At this moment, Su Qingxue moved.
